name: Block ads network-wide with Private DNS
summary: Points the TV's built-in Private DNS at a free, ad-blocking DNS-over-TLS resolver. Ads and trackers get blocked at the network level across every app — no root, no extra software. Fully reversible.
notes: Default resolver: AdGuard DNS (dns.adguard-dns.com) — a public, free, privacy resolver.
Change it with --dns <hostname>, e.g. --dns family.adguard-dns.com for family filtering.
This is the same 'Private DNS' feature in Android Settings, just set for you.
